why: a record rest of a parameter is one uninterpreted function of the source named by its excluded keys: Card and HasNote's candidates also take `note` out, so the spread div loses that prop and `"note" in rest` turns false (another function, not proved); Badge renames and reorders the same exclusions and rewrites the string (the same function, proved); OwnerLine reads fields of the remainder and is untouched; Sized changes the default of a field of an untyped source (the default is an argument of the field's function, not proved)
